BATCH 0 - VERIFY THE FOUNDATIONS (run this first)
Before I research individual tasks, check the identifiers my app is built on. Reply with a table: claim | CONFIRMED / CORRECTION / NOT VERIFIED | correct value | source URL. Then list anything important I have missed.

Claims to check (they come from my app and may contain errors):
1. NC Medicaid Clinical Coverage Policy 8G is "Peer Support Services". Billing code H0038, periodic, 15-minute unit. Qualified Professional (QP) supervision ratio 1:6. Peer caseload limit of 15.
2. "CCP 8A-12" is the policy for Substance Abuse Intensive Outpatient Program (SAIOP). Code H0015, ASAM Level 2.1, supervised by an LCAS or CCS clinical supervisor, 3 hours per day, 30-day pass-through authorization.
3. "CCP 8A-13" is the policy for Substance Abuse Comprehensive Outpatient Treatment (SACOT). Code H2036, ASAM Level 2.5, 20 or more hours per week (4 hours per day), 1:10 QP ratio, 60-day pass-through authorization.
4. Facility licensure for these services is under 10A NCAC 27G (including 27G .0201 governing body policies), issued by DHSR Mental Health Licensure and Certification Section.
5. "SL 2026-1" is a North Carolina session law relevant to these services. What is it, if it exists?
6. "APSM 45-2" is the NC documentation / records manual used for service notes. What is its current name, number and status?
7. NCTracks requires recredentialing every 5 years, and the revalidation reminders go out at 70, 50, 20 and 5 days.
8. Medicaid Tailored Plans: which LME/MCOs operate in which of NC's regions today, and which are the current provider-network contacts. (My app lists Vaya Health for Region 1, Partners for Regions 2-3, Alliance for Region 4, Trillium for Regions 5-6. Check that.)
9. "NC ROOTS" and "Rural Health Transformation" regional hubs listed in my app (Impact Health, Trillium, Vaya, UNC Health, Access East): do these exist and are they the hub leads?
10. Fees my app assumes: NC SOS filing $125; DHSR licensure base fee $350 plus $12.50 per day of capacity; NCTracks state enrollment fee $100 plus the federal application fee $709; fingerprinting $38 per person; background check $35-$75 per candidate. Give the current amounts and sources.
Also tell me whether these three services need Tailored Plan credentialing in addition to NCTracks enrollment, and in what order the steps normally happen.

# Batch 0: Foundation check (as of Oct 17–18, 2026)

Several identifiers in your app are wrong: the 8G ratio, the SACOT code, the pass-through authorization claims, the DHSR fee, the federal fee, the Tailored Plan map, and "APSM 45-2." The policy numbers, the ASAM levels and the 5-year revalidation cycle check out.

## Claim table

| # | Claim | Status | Correct value | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1a | CCP 8G = Peer Support Services | CONFIRMED | Amended Sept 1, 2026 (original effective Nov 1, 2019). Applies to NC Medicaid Direct and Managed Care. | 8G policy[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/8g-peer-support-services/open?share_frome=aipt), NC Medicaid bulletin[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/blog/2026/10/02/amendment-clinical-coverage-policy-8g-peer-support-services?share_frome=aipt) |
| 1b | H0038, 15-minute unit | CONFIRMED | H0038 = 15 minutes. H0038 HQ (group) is not telehealth or telephonic eligible. "Periodic" is not in the policy text I read. | 8G policy[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/8g-peer-support-services/open?share_frome=aipt) |
| 1c | QP supervision ratio 1:6 | CORRECTION | QP-to-CPSS is 1:8. | 8G §6.2.1[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/8g-peer-support-services/open?share_frome=aipt) |
| 1d | Peer caseload limit 15 | CONFIRMED, reframed | CPSS-to-beneficiary ratio is 1:15, and the group ratio is 1:12. The policy sets no fixed team caseload. | 8G §6.2.1[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/8g-peer-support-services/open?share_frome=aipt) |
| 2a | CCP 8A-12 = SAIOP | CONFIRMED | New stand-alone policy, effective Jan 1, 2026, and removed from CCP 8A. | NC Medicaid policy update[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/blog/2026/01/07/behavioral-health-clinical-coverage-policy-updates?share_frome=aipt), 8A-12[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15767/download?share_frome=aipt) |
| 2b | H0015, ASAM 2.1, LCAS/CCS supervisor | CONFIRMED | H0015 = 1 event per day, minimum 3 hours. Supervisor is LCAS, CCS or CSI. | 8A-12[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15767/download?share_frome=aipt) |
| 2c | "3 hours per day" | PARTIAL | The program runs 9–19 hours per week for adults (6–19 for adolescents). Billing needs at least 3 hours per day. | 8A-12[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15767/download?share_frome=aipt) |
| 2d | 30-day pass-through authorization | CORRECTION | "Medicaid shall not require prior approval for SAIOP" (§5.1). No pass-through period appears. | 8A-12[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15767/download?share_frome=aipt) |
| 3a | CCP 8A-13 = SACOT, ASAM 2.5, 20+ hours per week | CONFIRMED | Effective Jan 1, 2026. Adults 18 and older. Must operate at least 20 hours per week, with at least 4 scheduled hours per service day. | 8A-13[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15769/download?share_frome=aipt), policy update[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/blog/2026/01/07/behavioral-health-clinical-coverage-policy-updates?share_frome=aipt) |
| 3b | Code H2036 | CORRECTION | The code is H2035, 1 unit = 1 hour. Billing needs at least 4 hours per day. | 8A-13[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15769/download?share_frome=aipt) |
| 3c | 1:10 QP ratio | CORRECTION | The ratio is 1 clinical staff per 10 or fewer beneficiaries in group counseling. No separate QP ratio is stated. | 8A-13 §6.2[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15769/download?share_frome=aipt) |
| 3d | 60-day pass-through | CORRECTION | No prior approval is required (§5.1). The 60-day figure is from 8G (176 units per 60 days). | 8A-13[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15769/download?share_frome=aipt), 8G §5.2.2[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/8g-peer-support-services/open?share_frome=aipt) |
| 4 | 10A NCAC 27G; .0201 governing body; DHSR MHL | CONFIRMED | .0201 is "Governing Body Policies" (eff. May 1, 1996). SAIOP is licensed under 27G .4400 and SACOT under 27G .4500. 8G requires compliance with 27G but names no section. | 27G .0201[reports.oah.state.nc.us](http://reports.oah.state.nc.us/ncac/title%2010a%20-%20health%20and%20human%20services/chapter%2027%20-%20mental%20health,%20community%20facilities%20and%20services/subchapter%20g/10a%20ncac%2027g%20.0201.pdf?share_frome=aipt), 8A-12[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15767/download?share_frome=aipt), 8A-13[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15769/download?share_frome=aipt) |
| 5 | SL 2026-1 | CONFIRMED, exists | "An Act Making Various Changes to the Medicaid Program and Other Changes Related to HHS..." Ratified Apr 28, 2026. Became law Apr 30, 2026. Relevant: §3C.12 (open networks for PHPs, closed networks for Tailored Plans), §3C.13 (prepayment review threshold moves from 70% to 80%), §3C.14 (Medicaid credentialing and integrity plan, report due Oct 1, 2026, implementation no earlier than July 1, 2027). It does not mention NCTracks or peer support. | SL 2026-1[ncleg.gov](https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/SessionLaws/PDF/2025-2026/SL2026-1.pdf?share_frome=aipt) |
| 6 | APSM 45-2 | CORRECTION / NOT VERIFIED | I found no APSM 45-2. The current manual is the Records Management and Documentation Manual (RMDM), effective July 8, 2025. It replaced the 3rd Edition of 9-1-16. The manual cites APSM 10-5, 10-6, 30-1, 45-1 and 95-2. | DHHS RMDM page[ncdhhs.gov](https://www.ncdhhs.gov/divisions/mental-health-developmental-disabilities-and-substance-use-services/records-management-and-documentation-manual?share_frome=aipt), RMDM text[ncdhhs.gov](https://www.ncdhhs.gov/rmdmjuly-2025/download?attachment=&share_frome=aipt) |
| 7a | Recredentialing every 5 years | CONFIRMED | Revalidation every 5 years under the ACA. | NCTracks[nctracks.nc.gov](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/public/providers/provider-recredentialing.html?share_frome=aipt) |
| 7b | Notices at 70, 50, 20 and 5 days | CONFIRMED, refined | 70 days is the first notice. The reminders are at 50, 20 and 5 days. Missing the due date means suspension, then termination after 50 days of suspension. Separate license/accreditation expiry notices go out at 60, 30, 14 and 7 days. | NCTracks 2018 notice[nctracks.nc.gov](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/public/providers/provider-communications/2018-announcements/Changes-to-Re-credentialing-and-Reverification-Process.html?share_frome=aipt), NC Medicaid[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/providers/provider-enrollment/provider-enrollment-recredentialing?share_frome=aipt) |
| 8 | Region-based Tailored Plan map | CORRECTION | Tailored Plans are assigned by county, not by Regions 1–6. The three plans are Alliance (7 counties), Trillium (48 counties as listed), and Vaya Partners (47 counties). Partners no longer operates separately. See the section below. | NC Medicaid Plans[ncmedicaidplans.gov](https://www.ncmedicaidplans.gov/en/get-answers?share_frome=aipt), NCDHHS directory[ncdhhs.gov](https://www.ncdhhs.gov/providers/lme-mco-directory?share_frome=aipt) |
| 9 | NC ROOTS hub leads | CONFIRMED | The hub leads match your list. See the note below. | NCDHHS ROOTS page[ncdhhs.gov](https://www.ncdhhs.gov/about/department-initiatives/rural-health-transformation-program/rural-organizations-orchestrating-transformation-sustainability-roots-hub-leads?share_frome=aipt) |
| 10a | SOS $125 | CONFIRMED for LLC and business corporation | Nonprofit articles are $60. Certificate of Existence is $15. LLC annual report is $200. Expedited filing adds $100 (24 hours) or $200 (same day). | NC SOS fees[sosnc.gov](https://www.sosnc.gov/fees/by_title/_Business_Registration/?share_frome=aipt) |
| 10b | DHSR $350 + $12.50/day | CORRECTION | Non-residential facilities, including SAIOP and SACOT, pay a $265 base fee with no per-capacity fee. The $350 figure applies to residential facilities of 6 beds or fewer. Licenses renew yearly. Packet revision 10/01/25 (form MHL5001). | DHSR packet[info.ncdhhs.gov](https://info.ncdhhs.gov/dhsr/mhlcs/pdf/mhiapp.pdf?ver=2&share_frome=aipt) |
| 10c | NCTracks $100 + $709 | CORRECTION | $100 NC fee plus $750 federal fee for calendar year 2026, so $850 total. $709 was the 2024 figure. The fee applies at initial enrollment, re-enrollment, new owner or site, and revalidation. | NCTracks fee announcement[nctracks.nc.gov](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/public/providers/provider-communications/2025-Announcements/Federal-Provider-Enrollment-Application-Fee-Increase-for-Year-2026.html?share_frome=aipt), [fee history spreadsheet](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/dam/jcr:5088259c-ab17-4c01-bf6d-c64786be1da4/State%20and%20Federal%20Fee%20Amounts%20by%20Year.xlsx), NC fee FAQ[nctracks.nc.gov](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/public/providers/faq-main-page/faqs-for-ACA-application-fee.html?share_frome=aipt) |
| 10d | Fingerprinting $38 | NOT VERIFIED for NCTracks | NCTracks says the fee varies by location and states no amount. A DHSR-hosted SBI access form shows $38 per fingerprint card for national checks, but I could not confirm it applies to NCTracks or to your staff checks. | NCTracks fingerprint FAQ[nctracks.nc.gov](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/public/providers/faq-main-page/faqs-for-fingerprinting.html?share_frome=aipt), SBI form[info.ncdhhs.gov](https://info.ncdhhs.gov/dhsr/abcms/pdf/Non-Criminal-Justice-Access-Agreement-Form_SB-41.pdf?share_frome=aipt) |
| 10e | Staff background check $35–$75 | NOT VERIFIED | G.S. 143B-1209.20 caps the SBI State check fee at $14. No national check amount is stated, and private vendor prices vary. | G.S. 143B-1209.20[ncleg.gov](https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/BySection/Chapter_143B/GS_143B-1209.20.html?share_frome=aipt), G.S. 122C-80[ncleg.gov](https://ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/BySection/Chapter_122C/GS_122C-80.html?share_frome=aipt) |

## Tailored Plans and contacts (claim 8)

- **Alliance Health:** Cumberland, Durham, Harnett, Johnston, Mecklenburg, Orange and Wake counties. Provider network contact is 919-651-8500 or ProviderNetwork@alliancehealthplan.org per NC Medicaid health plans. The NCDHHS directory lists Provider Support at 855-759-9700.[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/about-nc-medicaid/health-plans?share_frome=aipt)[ncdhhs.gov](https://www.ncdhhs.gov/providers/lme-mco-directory?share_frome=aipt)
- **Trillium Health Resources:** Absorbed Sandhills and Eastpointe counties on Feb 1, 2024. Contact is 855-250-1539 or networkservicessupport@trilliumnc.org.[sandhillscenter.org](https://www.sandhillscenter.org/?share_frome=aipt)
- **Vaya Partners:** Vaya Health and Partners merged Oct 1, 2026. Vaya's provider page lists 866-990-9712 and provider.info@vayahealth.com. The NCDHHS directory lists 877-398-4145, which is the legacy Partners number. NCDHHS's directory also omits Cabarrus, while the NC Medicaid Plans page includes it. Verify by phone.[ncmedicaidplans.gov](https://www.ncmedicaidplans.gov/en/get-answers?share_frome=aipt)[vayahealth.com](https://www.vayahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Merger_Provider_FAQ.pdf?share_frome=aipt)[providers.partnersbhm.org](https://providers.partnersbhm.org/vaya-health-and-partners-health-management-announce-merger/?share_frome=aipt)
- **Your app's mapping:** Alliance is not "Region 4." It spans Medicaid Regions 3, 4 and 5. Partners no longer exists as a standalone plan, so the app's Partners entry is stale.

## NC ROOTS (claim 9)

The hub leads are Impact Health (Region 1), Trillium (Regions 2 and 5), Vaya (Region 3), UNC Health (Region 4) and Access East (Region 6). This is the Rural Health Transformation program run by NCDHHS, announced May 1, 2026. It is a regional grant and coordination network. It is not part of licensure, NCTracks enrollment or credentialing, so I would not put it in a provider-onboarding checklist. The ROOTS page still shows "Vaya Health," which is the pre-merger name.[ncdhhs.gov](https://www.ncdhhs.gov/news/press-releases/2026/05/01/ncdhhs-selects-nc-roots-hub-leads-strengthen-rural-health-care-across-north-carolina?share_frome=aipt)

## Tailored Plan credentialing and step order

Yes, you need plan contracting and credentialing in addition to NCTracks enrollment.

- **Policy requirement:** 8G §6.1 requires organizations to be "credentialed and contracted by a Prepaid Health Plan or Prepaid Inpatient Health Plan". 8A-12 and 8A-13 say "credentialed and contracted by the DHHS designated contractor."[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/8g-peer-support-services/open?share_frome=aipt)
- **Conflicting source:** An NCTracks FAQ says "LME/MCOs no longer perform credentialing." It is undated and the policies are newer, but the practical split between NCTracks and plan credentialing is NOT VERIFIED. Ask each plan.[nctracks.nc.gov](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/public/providers/faq-main-page/faqs-for-Behavioral-Health-Provider-Enrollment.html?share_frome=aipt)
- **NCTracks comes first:** Alliance and Trillium both require active NCTracks enrollment before applying. Trillium's manual is an older edition, so confirm it.[alliancehealthplan.org](https://www.alliancehealthplan.org/providers/network/become-a-provider/provider-enrollment/?share_frome=aipt)[trilliumhealthresources.org](https://www.trilliumhealthresources.org/sites/default/files/docs/Provider-documents/Provider-Manual/Trillium-Provider-Manual.pdf?share_frome=aipt)
- **Network access is need-based:** Alliance names peer support as a closed-network service and does not name SAIOP or SACOT. SL 2026-1 §3C.12 gives Tailored Plans closed-network authority for services excluded from PHP coverage. Alliance attributes its July 2, 2026 closed-network date to SB 257, which is SL 2026-41.[www3.ncleg.gov](https://www3.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/SessionLaws/PDF/2025-2026/SL2026-41.pdf?share_frome=aipt)
- **No contract with every plan is required.** Providers may contract with as many Tailored Plans as they choose.[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/contracting-tailored-plans/download?attachment=&share_frome=aipt)

Typical order:

1. Form the entity at the SOS.
2. Obtain an EIN and an organizational NPI. I did not research these, so verify them.
3. Contact the LME/MCOs early to learn network need. DHSR advises this for day programs seeking Medicaid.[info.ncdhhs.gov](https://info.ncdhhs.gov/dhsr/mhlcs/establish.html?share_frome=aipt)
4. Apply to DHSR for the license. The packet requires an SOS report showing active status, zoning approval, a fire marshal report and a floor plan. You have 6 months from first contact with the DHSR licensure team.
5. Enroll in NCTracks under taxonomy 251S00000X. The Provider Permission Matrix (PPM) dated Aug 16, 2026 requires the DHSR license for SAIOP and SACOT, but not for peer support.
6. Apply to each plan for credentialing and a contract.
7. Obtain national accreditation after enrollment.

## Items you missed

- **High-risk enrollment.** Taxonomy 251S00000X is high categorical risk. The PPM requires a site visit, fingerprinting and the federal fee for these services. Per a Sept 14, 2026 bulletin, the site visit and fingerprinting are waived only if you hold active national accreditation for the same location and service. Owners with 5% or more ownership are fingerprinted, and NCTracks sends the notice to the Office Administrator's email.[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/blog/2026/09/14/recent-behavioral-health-enrollment-updates-organizations?share_frome=aipt)
- **Accreditation conflict.** The April 2026 NCTracks notice and the PPM require accreditation within 1 year for peer support and within 3 years for SAIOP and SACOT. Policies 8A-12 and 8A-13 §6.1 say 1 year for both. The accepted bodies are COA, Joint Commission and CARF. The clock starts when you select the service at enrollment, since from April 20, 2026 NCTracks requires a service selection. Plan for 1 year until NC Medicaid clarifies.[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/blog/2026/04/16/post-enrollment-national-accreditation-update?share_frome=aipt)
- **8G changes effective Sept 1, 2026.** These include unmanaged units of 24 per episode, authorization of 176 units per 60 days (not more than 88 per 30 days), and a required NC Certified Peer Support Specialist (CPSS) roster. Telehealth and telephonic delivery is capped at 10% of service time per beneficiary per fiscal year (the bulletin's wording is "less than 10% or less"). Service notes must show start and end times.
- **Peer support licensure.** The PPM does not require a DHSR license for peer support. Whether the service is licensable under G.S. 122C-3(14) is NOT VERIFIED. Call the DHSR licensure section at 919-855-3795.
- **Federal fee timing.** The $750 federal fee is the 2026 amount. The 2027 amount takes effect Jan 1, 2027, and I did not verify it. If your application slips into 2027, budget for a change.
- **New credentialing committee.** NCDHHS now has a Provider Credentialing Committee that issues final determinations on applications.[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/provider-enrollment-2026-summer-and-fall-series-1-powerpoint/open?share_frome=aipt)
- **Medicaid regions versus plan counties.** Regions 1–6 are the Standard Plan and ROOTS geography, so do not use them to pick a Tailored Plan. Use the county where the beneficiary's Medicaid is administered.

## Open questions

- Is NCTracks the only credentialing step, or does each Tailored Plan also run its own? Call each plan's provider network line.
- What is the actual cost per person for NCTracks fingerprinting and for staff national checks? Call the NCTracks Call Center at 800-688-6696.
- Which accreditation deadline governs SAIOP and SACOT, 1 year or 3 years? Ask the Provider Ombudsman at 866-304-7062.
- Is peer support licensable at your site? Call the DHSR licensure section at 919-855-3795.
- Will Vaya Partners change its provider portal, contacts and credentialing process after Oct 1, 2026? Check with Vaya Partners.

This is research, not legal advice. Have a healthcare attorney or the agencies confirm the items above before you rely on them. When you're ready, send the first set of task keys.

BATCH 0 - VERIFY THE FOUNDATIONS (run this first)
Before I research individual tasks, check the identifiers my app is built on. Reply with a table: claim | CONFIRMED / CORRECTION / NOT VERIFIED | correct value | source URL. Then list anything important I have missed.

Claims to check (they come from my app and may contain errors):
1. NC Medicaid Clinical Coverage Policy 8G is "Peer Support Services". Billing code H0038, periodic, 15-minute unit. Qualified Professional (QP) supervision ratio 1:6. Peer caseload limit of 15.
2. "CCP 8A-12" is the policy for Substance Abuse Intensive Outpatient Program (SAIOP). Code H0015, ASAM Level 2.1, supervised by an LCAS or CCS clinical supervisor, 3 hours per day, 30-day pass-through authorization.
3. "CCP 8A-13" is the policy for Substance Abuse Comprehensive Outpatient Treatment (SACOT). Code H2036, ASAM Level 2.5, 20 or more hours per week (4 hours per day), 1:10 QP ratio, 60-day pass-through authorization.
4. Facility licensure for these services is under 10A NCAC 27G (including 27G .0201 governing body policies), issued by DHSR Mental Health Licensure and Certification Section.
5. "SL 2026-1" is a North Carolina session law relevant to these services. What is it, if it exists?
6. "APSM 45-2" is the NC documentation / records manual used for service notes. What is its current name, number and status?
7. NCTracks requires recredentialing every 5 years, and the revalidation reminders go out at 70, 50, 20 and 5 days.
8. Medicaid Tailored Plans: which LME/MCOs operate in which of NC's regions today, and which are the current provider-network contacts. (My app lists Vaya Health for Region 1, Partners for Regions 2-3, Alliance for Region 4, Trillium for Regions 5-6. Check that.)
9. "NC ROOTS" and "Rural Health Transformation" regional hubs listed in my app (Impact Health, Trillium, Vaya, UNC Health, Access East): do these exist and are they the hub leads?
10. Fees my app assumes: NC SOS filing $125; DHSR licensure base fee $350 plus $12.50 per day of capacity; NCTracks state enrollment fee $100 plus the federal application fee $709; fingerprinting $38 per person; background check $35-$75 per candidate. Give the current amounts and sources.
Also tell me whether these three services need Tailored Plan credentialing in addition to NCTracks enrollment, and in what order the steps normally happen.

# Batch 0: Foundation check, with H.R. 1 added (Oct 18, 2026)

Your updated instructions add an H.R. 1 phase, so I researched it and added a section below. The ten claim checks are unchanged from my earlier pass. The H.R. 1 items most relevant to these three services start Jan 1, 2027.

## Claim table

| # | Claim | Status | Correct value | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1a | CCP 8G = Peer Support Services | CONFIRMED | Amended Sept 1, 2026. | [8G policy](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/8g-peer-support-services/open), [NC Medicaid bulletin](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/blog/2026/10/02/amendment-clinical-coverage-policy-8g-peer-support-services) |
| 1b | H0038, 15-minute unit | CONFIRMED | "Periodic" is not in the policy text I read. | [8G policy](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/8g-peer-support-services/open) |
| 1c | QP supervision ratio 1:6 | CORRECTION | QP-to-CPSS (NC Certified Peer Support Specialist) is 1:8. | [8G §6.2.1](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/8g-peer-support-services/open) |
| 1d | Peer caseload limit 15 | CONFIRMED, reframed | The CPSS-to-beneficiary ratio is 1:15, and the group ratio is 1:12. There is no fixed team caseload. | [8G §6.2.1](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/8g-peer-support-services/open) |
| 2a | CCP 8A-12 = SAIOP | CONFIRMED | Stand-alone policy, effective Jan 1, 2026. | [policy update](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/blog/2026/01/07/behavioral-health-clinical-coverage-policy-updates), [8A-12](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15767/download) |
| 2b | H0015, ASAM 2.1, LCAS/CCS supervisor | CONFIRMED | The supervisor may also be a CSI. | [8A-12](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15767/download) |
| 2c | 3 hours per day | PARTIAL | The program runs 9–19 hours per week for adults. Billing needs at least 3 hours per day. | [8A-12](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15767/download) |
| 2d | 30-day pass-through | CORRECTION | "Medicaid shall not require prior approval for SAIOP" (§5.1). | [8A-12](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15767/download) |
| 3a | CCP 8A-13 = SACOT, ASAM 2.5, 20+ hours per week | CONFIRMED | Effective Jan 1, 2026. Adults 18 and older. At least 4 hours per service day. | [8A-13](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15769/download) |
| 3b | H2036 | CORRECTION | The code is H2035, 1 unit = 1 hour. | [8A-13](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15769/download) |
| 3c | 1:10 QP ratio | CORRECTION | The ratio is 1 clinical staff per 10 or fewer in group counseling. | [8A-13 §6.2](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15769/download) |
| 3d | 60-day pass-through | CORRECTION | No prior approval is required. The 60-day figure comes from 8G authorization periods. | [8A-13](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/15769/download), [8G §5.2.2](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/8g-peer-support-services/open) |
| 4 | 10A NCAC 27G; .0201; DHSR | CONFIRMED | .0201 is "Governing Body Policies." SAIOP is under 27G .4400 and SACOT under 27G .4500. | 27G .0201[reports.oah.state.nc.us](http://reports.oah.state.nc.us/ncac/title%2010a%20-%20health%20and%20human%20services/chapter%2027%20-%20mental%20health,%20community%20facilities%20and%20services/subchapter%20g/10a%20ncac%2027g%20.0201.pdf?share_frome=aipt), 27G .4501[reports.oah.state.nc.us](http://reports.oah.state.nc.us/ncac/title%2010a%20-%20health%20and%20human%20services/chapter%2027%20-%20mental%20health,%20community%20facilities%20and%20services/subchapter%20g/10a%20ncac%2027g%20.4501.html?share_frome=aipt) |
| 5 | SL 2026-1 | CONFIRMED, exists | HB 696, "An Act Making Various Changes to the Medicaid Program and Other Changes Related to HHS." Became law Apr 30, 2026. §3C.12 covers open and closed provider networks. It does not mention NCTracks or peer support. | [SL 2026-1](https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/SessionLaws/PDF/2025-2026/SL2026-1.pdf), HTML[ncleg.gov](https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/SessionLaws/HTML/2025-2026/SL2026-1.html?share_frome=aipt) |
| 6 | APSM 45-2 | CORRECTION / NOT VERIFIED | I found no APSM 45-2. The current manual is the Records Management and Documentation Manual, effective July 8, 2025. Policies 8A-12 and 8A-13 §5.5 require service notes to meet it. | [DHHS manual page](https://www.ncdhhs.gov/divisions/mental-health-developmental-disabilities-and-substance-use-services/records-management-and-documentation-manual), manual[ncdhhs.gov](https://www.ncdhhs.gov/rmdmjuly-2025/download?attachment=&share_frome=aipt) |
| 7 | 5-year revalidation; notices at 70, 50, 20 and 5 days | CONFIRMED, refined | 70 days is the first notice, and 50, 20 and 5 are reminders. A missed deadline means suspension, then termination. | [NCTracks](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/public/providers/provider-recredentialing.html), [NCTracks 2018 notice](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/public/providers/provider-communications/2018-announcements/Changes-to-Re-credentialing-and-Reverification-Process.html) |
| 8 | Region-based Tailored Plan map | CORRECTION | Tailored Plans are assigned by county, not by Regions 1–6. Alliance has 7 counties. Trillium absorbed Sandhills and Eastpointe on Feb 1, 2024. Vaya Partners (Vaya and Partners merged Oct 1, 2026) has 47. | [NC Medicaid Plans](https://www.ncmedicaidplans.gov/en/get-answers), [NCDHHS directory](https://www.ncdhhs.gov/providers/lme-mco-directory), [Vaya merger FAQ](https://www.vayahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Merger_Provider_FAQ.pdf) |
| 9 | NC ROOTS hub leads | CONFIRMED | Impact Health (Region 1), Trillium (Regions 2 and 5), Vaya (Region 3), UNC Health (Region 4), Access East (Region 6). They are not tied to licensure or enrollment. | [NCDHHS ROOTS page](https://www.ncdhhs.gov/about/department-initiatives/rural-health-transformation-program/rural-organizations-orchestrating-transformation-sustainability-roots-hub-leads) |
| 10a | SOS $125 | CONFIRMED for LLC | Nonprofit articles are $60. Certificate of Existence is $15. LLC annual report is $200. | [NC SOS fees](https://www.sosnc.gov/fees/by_title/_Business_Registration/) |
| 10b | DHSR $350 + $12.50/day | CORRECTION | Non-residential facilities (SAIOP/SACOT) pay a $265 base fee with no per-capacity fee. The $350 figure is for residential facilities of 6 beds or fewer. | [DHSR packet](https://info.ncdhhs.gov/dhsr/mhlcs/pdf/mhiapp.pdf?ver=2) |
| 10c | NCTracks $100 + $709 | CORRECTION | The 2026 federal fee is $750, so the total is $850. $709 was the 2024 amount. | [NCTracks fee notice](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/public/providers/provider-communications/2025-Announcements/Federal-Provider-Enrollment-Application-Fee-Increase-for-Year-2026.html), [fee history](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/dam/jcr:5088259c-ab17-4c01-bf6d-c64786be1da4/State%20and%20Federal%20Fee%20Amounts%20by%20Year.xlsx) |
| 10d | Fingerprinting $38 | NOT VERIFIED for NCTracks | NCTracks says the cost varies by location. A SBI access form shows $38 per card for national checks. | [NCTracks FAQ](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/public/providers/faq-main-page/faqs-for-fingerprinting.html), SBI form[info.ncdhhs.gov](https://info.ncdhhs.gov/dhsr/abcms/pdf/Non-Criminal-Justice-Access-Agreement-Form_SB-41.pdf?share_frome=aipt) |
| 10e | Background check $35–$75 | NOT VERIFIED | The statutory cap on the SBI State check fee is $14. National check pricing is not stated. | G.S. 143B-1209.20[ncleg.gov](https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/BySection/Chapter_143B/GS_143B-1209.20.html?share_frome=aipt) |

Plan contacts as verified earlier:

- **Alliance:** 919-651-8500 or ProviderNetwork@alliancehealthplan.org ([NC Medicaid health plans](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/about-nc-medicaid/health-plans)).
- **Trillium:** 855-250-1539.
- **Vaya Partners:** 866-990-9712 per Vaya's own page. The NCDHHS directory lists a different number, 877-398-4145, so verify by phone.

## Credentialing and step order

Yes, you need Tailored Plan contracting and credentialing in addition to NCTracks enrollment.

- **Policy requirement:** 8G §6.1 requires organizations to be "credentialed and contracted by a Prepaid Health Plan or Prepaid Inpatient Health Plan" ([8G](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/8g-peer-support-services/open)).
- **Conflicting source:** An undated [NCTracks FAQ](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/public/providers/faq-main-page/faqs-for-Behavioral-Health-Provider-Enrollment.html) says LME/MCOs no longer perform credentialing. The policies are newer. Ask each plan what it still requires.
- **NCTracks comes first:** Alliance requires NCTracks enrollment before you apply to its network.[alliancehealthplan.org](https://www.alliancehealthplan.org/providers/network/become-a-provider/provider-enrollment/?share_frome=aipt)

Typical order:

1. Form the entity at the SOS.
2. Get an EIN and an organizational NPI. I did not research these.
3. Ask the plans about network need.
4. Apply for the DHSR license. SAIOP and SACOT need it, and the [Provider Permission Matrix](https://www.nctracks.nc.gov/content/dam/jcr:4f0d2400-62b7-48a3-9617-ad31dd8cf543/Provider%20Permission%20Matrix%2008-16-2026.xlsx) does not require it for peer support.
5. Enroll in NCTracks under taxonomy 251S00000X. This is high risk, so expect a site visit, fingerprinting and the federal fee.
6. Apply to each plan.
7. Obtain accreditation. Policies 8A-12 and 8A-13 say 1 year. The permission matrix says 3 years for SAIOP and SACOT. See the April 2026 notice. Plan for 1 year.[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/blog/2026/04/16/post-enrollment-national-accreditation-update?share_frome=aipt)

## H.R. 1 status for these services

I've separated what is statute, what CMS has issued, and what NC has announced. Each item has its date.

**Statute (Public Law 119-21)**
- **§71119 (work and community engagement):** States must condition expansion-adult eligibility on 80 hours per month of qualifying activity or equivalent income, starting Jan 1, 2027. Two exemptions matter for your patients:
  - Individuals "with a substance use disorder," under the medically frail category, subsection (xx)(9)(A)(ii)(V)(bb).
  - Individuals "participating in a drug addiction or alcoholic treatment and rehabilitation program," subsection (xx)(9)(A)(ii)(VII).
- **Good-faith exemption:** The Secretary may exempt a state that shows a good-faith effort. Any such exemption expires no later than Dec 31, 2028.[law.cornell.edu](https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/42/1396a?share_frome=aipt)
- **Other timing:** Six-month redeterminations (§71107) and shorter retroactive coverage (§71112) also start Jan 1, 2027. Qualified-alien eligibility (§71109) starts Oct 1, 2026.[webservices.ncleg.gov](https://webservices.ncleg.gov/ViewDocSiteFile/104990?share_frome=aipt)

**CMS**
- CMS issued an interim final rule (CMS-2454-IFC) on June 1, 2026.[cms.gov](https://www.cms.gov/newsroom/fact-sheets/medicaid-community-engagement-requirement-certain-individuals-interim-final-rule-comment-period-cms?share_frome=aipt)
- It was published in the Federal Register on June 3, 2026. It took effect July 31, 2026, and comments closed Aug 1, 2026.[federalregister.gov](https://www.federalregister.gov/api/v1/documents/2026-11094?publication_date=2026-06-03&share_frome=aipt)
- CMS's fact sheet lists participants in drug or alcohol treatment programs and medically frail people as exempt. It requires a 30-day notice of noncompliance and does not state a provider attestation requirement.
- The CMS guidance bulletin was posted Dec 8, 2025.[medicaid.gov](https://www.medicaid.gov/resources-for-states/working-families-tax-cut-legislation/community-engagement?share_frome=aipt)

**NC announcements**
- NC applies the requirement Jan 1, 2027. The exemption list on NC Medicaid's page includes "In a drug addiction or alcohol treatment and rehabilitation program" and "Has a substance use disorder." The page is dated Oct 13, 2026.[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/beneficiaries/impact-hr-1-and-federal-changes-medicaid/work-and-community-engagement-requirement?share_frome=aipt)
- Members must meet the requirement in 3 of the 6 months before recertification.
- Retroactive coverage drops from 3 months to 1 month for most expansion-age adults on Jan 1, 2027.[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/beneficiaries/medicaid-is-changing?share_frome=aipt)
- NC still describes the medically frail pathway as undefined, and tells people to keep proof and contact their county Department of Social Services.
- I found no NC good-faith exemption request. That is NOT VERIFIED.
- The NC legislative deck lists provider-related and payment/financing provisions as "not currently in scope." It also lists the expansion-adult copayments (§71120) as not currently in scope. Provider taxes (§71115) and state directed payments (§71116) are not itemized there.

**What this means for your checklist**
- Your patients may be exempt, but the member must document it. The legislative deck says providers should expect more requests for medical documentation to support exemption and disability determinations.
- Plan for coverage churn. Six-month renewals and the shorter look-back mean more eligibility checks before billing. Verify eligibility on the date of service.[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/providers/programs-and-services/prior-approval-and-due-process?share_frome=aipt)
- NC's provider-facing H.R. 1 page did not load, so I could not read it. Check it before you finalize that phase.

## Other items you missed

- **High-risk enrollment.** The Sept 14, 2026 bulletin says the site visit and fingerprinting are waived only with active national accreditation for the same location and service.[medicaid.ncdhhs.gov](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/blog/2026/09/14/recent-behavioral-health-enrollment-updates-organizations?share_frome=aipt)
- **42 CFR Part 2.** HHS says the SUD records rule's compliance date and enforcement start are Feb 16, 2026. SAIOP and SACOT likely fall under it. I did not confirm which of your services are Part 2 programs, so confirm that with an attorney.[hhs.gov](https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/regulatory-initiatives/fact-sheet-42-cfr-part-2-final-rule/index.html?share_frome=aipt)[hhs.gov](https://www.hhs.gov/press-room/hhs-announce-civil-enforcement-program-sud-patient-records.html?share_frome=aipt)
- **8G changes (effective Sept 1, 2026).** Unmanaged units are 24 per episode. Authorization is up to 176 units per 60 days. Telehealth is limited to 10% of service time.
- **Peer support licensure.** Whether it needs a DHSR license is NOT VERIFIED. Call DHSR at 919-855-3795.
- **2027 federal fee.** The 2027 federal fee takes effect Jan 1, 2027 and I did not verify it.

## Open questions

- Does NC plan to request a good-faith exemption that delays the work requirement past Jan 1, 2027? Check NC Medicaid's H.R. 1 page or the NC Medicaid contact center.
- Which accreditation deadline governs SAIOP and SACOT, 1 year or 3 years? Ask the NC Medicaid Provider Ombudsman at 866-304-7062.
- What do NCTracks fingerprinting and staff national checks actually cost? Call the NCTracks Call Center at 800-688-6696.
- Is a separate credentialing step required by each Tailored Plan? Call each plan's provider network line.
- Is peer support licensable at your site? Call DHSR at 919-855-3795.

This is research, not legal advice. Have a healthcare attorney confirm the Part 2 and H.R. 1 items before you rely on them. Send the first set of task keys when you're ready.
